coverage: Ten benchmarks in both languages, distinct compact and performance candidates, with all valid baseline sources retained for measurement.

nbody.techniques: Compact literals and direct state flow; SIMD pair updates and compile-time unrolling in Mojo, explicit scalar state in Futhark. All ten pairs and five positions every step.

spectralnorm.techniques: Compact four-function multiplication; SIMD/parallel row kernels in Mojo, four-row shared-load tiling in Futhark. Evaluate every coefficient during all forty products.

mandelbrot.techniques: Scalar compact loop; four-lane masked iteration and parallel rows. Same grid, fifty-iteration escape loop and complete PBM, no analytic interior tests.

knucleotide.techniques: Serial compact growing maps; rolling keys, one-search entry increments, 32 partitions/eight workers, bounded reserve plus fixed-shape inner updates in Futhark. Retain all keys.

revcomp.techniques: Compact parsing/reversal/wrapping; a reusable complement lookup and parallel output construction. Preserve headers, every input base and sixty-column output.

fasta.techniques: Compact single record generator; UInt32 LCG state and parallel floating-CDF conversion after sequential generation. Preserve every RNG update.

binarytrees.techniques: Compact recursive construction/traversal; smaller child indices, contiguous storage, ordinary pool reuse and leaf traversal checks. Compiler barriers prevent invariant-work collapse.

fannkuchredux.techniques: Compact factoradic enumeration; disjoint worker ranges, native pointer updates in Mojo and fixed-size array loops in Futhark. Enumerate all permutations.

regexredux.techniques: Compact pattern literals; parallel independent searches and general one-pass replacement/bit-mask access improvements. Keep all nine searches and five ordered substitutions.

pidigits.techniques: Compact ordinary unbounded-integer operators; fused GMP product/sum in Mojo, leading-limb quotient estimation with exact corrections in Futhark. Preserve sequential LFT and dual extraction.

selection: After measurement, select the lowest-LOC and lowest-median-time admitted source from the complete candidate pool. A performance attempt may lose to its baseline; both attempts are recorded.
